text:
maria: quick check — where are we on the token-cost attribution schema? need to freeze final fields so billing + latency teams can run queries by EOD Wed.
aj: hitting a blocker, PR #4821 fails ingest smoke with SchemaValidationError: missing field token_cost_v2 from async-proxy. i can add a fix but need owners to confirm type and fallback behavior.
kevin: i'm owner for the mapping. token_cost_v2 should be integer microunits. also adding optional token_cost_currency string. PR looks OK but proxy is still sending old envelope shape.
dina: eng-sre can stand up a short-lived compatibility shim in prod-ingest to accept both shapes for up to 48h. propose: only hard-fail when token_cost_v2 is present and wrong type; otherwise accept and derive.
maria: fallback policy sounds right. to be explicit: - if token_cost_v2 present, validate type (integer microunits) - if absent, synthesize token_cost_v2 from token_cost (v1) during canary window - keep shim 48h, then enforce. please confirm here so i can add to rollout doc.
telemetry-bot: alert — ingestion error rate +0.8% in prod-ingest last 10m. top error: SchemaValidationError: missing field token_cost_v2
sam: i'll take CR review on #4821, aiming to finish by 16:00 PT. if kevin signs off on microunit integer we can merge and trigger shim rollout.
kevin: confirmed microunit integer. add a schema comment about units and a short migration note for billing. cc olivia for currency mapping.
olivia: billing needs token_cost_currency mapped; if absent default to USD in downstream ETL. also want a small latency sample set from canary so we can compare cost rollups vs observed spend.
aj: adding two minimal sample payloads to the canary branch: one with token_cost_v2 present and one without. snippet:
```
{
  "event": "token_emit",
  "token_cost_v2": 1250,
  "token_cost_currency": "USD",
  "sequence_len": 64,
  "source": "proxy-a"
}
```
kevin: please also include a sample where token_cost_v2 is absent so shim path is exercised.
aj: pushed the absent-field test to canary branch.
olivia: i'll run aggregation parity tomorrow AM against the canary dataset. canary retention of 72h would be ideal.
dina: infra will set canary retention to 72h and open a short-lived ticket to track the shim lifecycle.
maria: milestone recap: (1) kevin add schema comment & migration note (2) aj merge PR + absent-field test (3) dina deploy shim 48h with fallback policy (4) olivia run parity check by tomorrow AM. target: promote to staging canary Thu morning. who is offline Fri? avoid Fri promotions.
sam: i'm out Fri afternoon but available in the morning for merge window.
kevin: remote all week, can help with rollforward.
aj: i'll update PR description with fallback policy and add a test matrix for ingest/compat cases.
maria: thanks — i'll update the roadmap and send a quick 15m sync invite for tomorrow 09:30 PT. post any regressions here otherwise we'll close after parity check.
deploy-bot: canary shim deployed to prod-ingest-compat-166 — rollout 10% traffic — started 12:34 UTC
maria: monitoring errors now, ping this thread if you see anything abnormal. will close once olivia confirms parity.
